## Lib/eacp/Network/Rpc/AsyncCommand.h

- fn `void runOnWorkerThread(Callback work)` — eacp::Rpc — AsyncCommand.h:18 — Runs `work` on a detached worker thread.
- enum class `CommandExecution` — eacp::Rpc — AsyncCommand.h:24 — Selects how a bridge executes a command when turning a caller's request into an async one.
  - `MainThreadDeferred` = 0 — Default. Run the handler on a later main-thread tick, then deliver the result.
  - `WorkerThread` = 1 — Run the handler on a worker thread, then marshal the result back to the main thread to deliver.
